responsibility: This header exposes the public middle-end interface for builtin processing and expansion. It declares target_builtins state, builtin expansion and folding entry points, helpers for builtin string/object-size analysis, va_list and setjmp support, target character constants, builtin classification queries, and internal-fn association helpers, making it the API used by expr/calls/optimization code to recognize, fold, and lower built-ins.
same_name_distinction: Public header in the `builtins` group: it declares the builtin-processing state and helper APIs consumed by other middle-end code, while `gcc/builtins.cc` provides the implementation and `gcc/builtins.def` supplies the declarative builtin list.
